summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty. Core-shell passes 'platform', billing 'payments' (from package.json team), and reports 'insights' (also calls validateApp, so would have broken). Assumptions: libs/shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time (per CONTRIBUTING), so there is no registry release or dependency bump; I bumped its version to 2.0.0 to mark the breaking change. Shipped as a single PR (#1) since lib and consumers must land together. CI and CD green.
